inputs.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct fundamental thesis from admissible public company information, screen Legacy before freeze, include active disconfirmation and falsification, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without outcome-driven tuning.

allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
inspect admissible public statements, filings, guidance and business-model evidence
map causal thesis, valuation logic, catalyst, falsification and confounders
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE
success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct fundamental CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.
